description: React component for a user profile dropdown menu in the top navigation bar, including avatar, display name, email, and links for profile, settings, and sign out.

methods.name: computeDisplayName
methods.description: Computes a display name based on profile and user data, prioritizing local profile name, then user metadata, then email.

methods.name: computeEmail
methods.description: Returns the user's email or fallback to profile email.

methods.name: initialsFor
methods.description: Generates initials from a name or email, handling email local parts and name parts.

methods.name: TopbarProfileDropdown
methods.description: Main React component rendering the profile dropdown menu with avatar, name, email, and menu actions.
